sample.task:
[SCHOOL OF BALANCE, KROKOTOPIA]

Trixie Sphinxeyes: (speaking to her friend) "Oh! Hello there, [Your Wizard's Name]! Man, I can't wait to learn my next Balance spell. Can't you?"
sample.chosen:
[Your Wizard's Name]: "Hi Trixie! I'm really excited too. Balance magic is so versatile, and I can't wait to see what we'll learn next. What spell are you hoping to learn?"

Trixie Sphinxeyes: "I've heard rumors about a spell called 'Sandstorm.' It's supposed to be really powerful and useful in lots of situations. How about you?"

[Your Wizard's Name]: "Sandstorm sounds amazing! I've been curious about 'Elemental Blade' myself. It seems like a great support spell to boost our allies' attacks. Have you heard anything about it?"

Trixie Sphinxeyes: "Oh, yeah! 'Elemental Blade' is supposed to be great for team battles. I think we'll both learn some fantastic spells here at the School of Balance. Let's practice together sometime!"

[Your Wizard's Name]: "That sounds like a great idea, Trixie. We can help each other improve and maybe even come up with some cool combo strategies. See you in class!"

Trixie Sphinxeyes: "Definitely! See you later, [Your Wizard's Name]!"
